texts.preamble: Smt. Pooja Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 27 February, 2019 1 Mc
texts.facts: This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner to [LEAKAGE_MASK] the impugned complaint dated 11.12.2017 and the proceedings under Section 3(1)(zz)(v) and 262)(i) punishable under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. It appears that the complainant/respondent being Food Safety Officer seized certain split chana dal (gram) from the possession of Sonu Rajak and Dilip Rajak and on verification it is found that the dal was of sub-standard. It is submitted that on behalf of the petitioner that Sonu Rajak and Dilip Rajak were neither the employees of the petitioner nor the petitioner had committed any offence. Moreover, it is further submitted that previously there was a demand by the respondent for some money, which was not satisfied and later on, the complaint has been filed before the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Satna with ulterior motive. However, according to the submissions, the petitioner is running a society in the name of Pooja Mahila Sva-Sahayata Samuh and there is no such ulterior motive of the petitioner to sell adulterated or substandard goods.
